items.name: Sandnes Open 2025

venue.name: Austrått Bydelshus
venue.details: Main door and to the left

items.information:
## 🇳🇴 Informasjon
Velkommen til Sandnes Open 2025! Denne konkurransen er åpen for alle som ønsker å delta.

### On The Spot Registreringer
Det vil bli mulig å registrere seg på lokalet for denne konkurransen. Dette koster 170kr og betaling vil bli gjort gjennom Vipps. Dersom du ikke har en Vipps-konto kommer vi til å tilby andre alternativer. Vi oppfordrer alle allikevel å [registrere seg på nett](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2025/register) for å sikre at de får plass på konkurransen.

### Førstegangsdeltakere
Førstegangsdeltakere er veldig velkommen til å delta. Det stilles ingen krav om hvor rask man må være for å delta, og vi ønsker å se flest mulig velge å være med.

---

## 🇺🇸 Information
Welcome to Sandnes Open 2025! The competition is open to all who wish to compete.

### On The Spot Registration
Competitors may register on the spot for a fee of 170 NOK. The payment must be made at the time of registration and will preferaly be done though Vipps. Alternatives will be available for competitors who do not have a Vipps-account. We strongly advice all competitors to [register online](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SandnesOpen2025/register) to ensure they are able to get a spot.

### First-Time Competitors
First-time competitors are very welcome to compete. There are no requirements in regards to how fast one needs to be to compete, and we would like as many people as possible to attend the competition.

items.information:
If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the **FAQ** and the **Important Information** tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

**Spectators may attend for free!**

[![UKCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBb0I0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--1c7aaa67674e675ba6f477cf783142702a671457/UKCA_Logo.png)](https://www.ukca.org/)
[![Cuboss](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcUNBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--055513fb6e7e1e8b0dbd1cb81eb908d714eb048b/cuboss-logo-600px.png)](https://cuboss.com/)

**PLEASE NOTE**: For this competition, there will be competitor limits for some events:
***- 6x6 and 7x7: first 40 to register***
Spaces are available on a first come first served basis. If you are amongst the first 40 (6x6/7x7) to register for those events, you will get a space in them. If you are not within the first people registered, your registration for that event will be removed after the close of registration. However we will be keeping waiting list for these specific events in the case of dropouts before registration closes. Please only consider registering for these events if you are certain you would like to compete in them.

venue.name: Colégio Asther
venue.address: Rua Frei José de Monte Carmelo 898 – Jardim Paraiso – Campinas-SP

items.information:
## Português

* O pagamento da inscrição deve ser feito antecipadamente, todas as instruções se encontram na aba de *inscrever-se* do campeonato.
* A inscrição **NÃO** será aceita até que o pagamento e o comprovante sejam enviados. Sem isso sua inscrição não será aprovada e você não poderá competir.

***A inscrição só será efetivada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento. Assim, as inscrições estarão limitadas aos 60 primeiros pagantes. Caso o número de inscritos exceda este limite, será usada uma lista de espera de acordo com a ordem do pagamento.***

--------------------

## English

* The payment of the registration fee must be made in advance. All the relevant instructions can be found under the *register* tab.
* The registration **WILL NOT** be accepted until the payment is done and the receipt is sent. Otherwise, your registration will not be accepted and you will not be allowed to competed at the day of the competition.

***Registration will only be confirmed at the WCA website after payment confirmation. Thus, registrations will be limited to the first 60 payers. If the number of registrations exceeds this limit, a waiting list will be put in place ordered by de date of payment.***

items.information:
Swisscubing Cup V ist Teil des Swisscubing Cup 2025. Dieser besteht aus 8 Competitions über das ganze Jahr verteilt. Um mehr darüber zu erfahren, besuche unsere [Website](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/). Die Website für den Swisscubingcup 2025 folgt. 

Teilnehmer die sich registrieren aber nicht bezahlen, müssen die Teilnahmegebühr bei ihrer nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen.
______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup V is part of the Swisscubing Cup 2025, made of 8 competitions during the whole year. Check out our [website](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/) for the details of the other editions. The website for the Swisscubingcup 2025 will follow.

A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.
______________________________________________________________________________________________

Swisscubing Cup II fait partie de la Swisscubing Cup 2025, composé de 8 compétitions durant l'année. Jette un oeil sur notre [site web](https://swisscubing.ch/swisscubing-cup-2025/) pour plus de détails sur les autres éditions. Le site web de la Swisscubingcup 2025 suivra.
